note: *** Georgina Temple, ten years on, and now a widow in her own household. *** In 1851 she was a married lodger in her father-in-law's house with her husband five weeks from death in the county asylum. *** Her trade has changed with her circumstances: "Shoemaker Wife" in 1851, "Mangles Clothes" in 1861. *** The tree renders her occupation "Monthly Nurse & Shoemaker Wife Pauper", which now reads like three census returns run together.

*** THE DAUGHTER THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE, CONFIRMED A SECOND TIME AND TEN YEARS APART. *** Same birthplace as 1851 - St Andrew in the City of London - and still at home at twenty. *** She is a real person and not a transcription ghost. ***

*** AND THE AGE SETTLES IT FOR THE THIRD TIME. *** He is 16 in April 1861, so born about 1845 - which is the tree's 22 June 1845 and *** not *** the 1900 death index's implied 1847. *** Two censuses now agree against one informant, and the tree wins. *** His trade is new to this archive: porter to a druggist, at sixteen.
Georgina Margaret. *** Eight months old in 1851 and ten in 1861, which agrees with a birth about July 1850 *** and confirms again that the tree's "b. 1851" is a year late.
Not family. Recorded because a household return records the house.

*** THIS IS MARY ANN HELLEN BRAYLEY, AND IT IS THE TREE'S OWN WORDS ON A RECORD. *** The current tree gives her occupation as *** "House Servant" *** and nothing to support it. *** Here it is, written by an enumerator in 1861. *** She is living in the household of *** MICHAEL PRUST, 64, widower, CHINA DEALER, of Hartland ***, with his daughters *** Naomi, 36, and Eliza, 30, China Dealer Assistants. *** *** And she went into service FOUR DOORS FROM HER MOTHER *** - schedule 38 against her mother's 27, on the same street. Nine years later she married William Taylor at Bideford.

*** THE MASON OF 1851, TEN YEARS ON, WIDOWED AND LIVING BY HIMSELF. *** In 1851 he was 74, head of a lodging house full of boarders and his son's family. *** Peggy is gone - the tree says she died 23 January 1858 at Lower Gunstone, and he is a widower at the same address. *** *** "Formerly a mason" is the whole of a working life in three words. *** The tree has him dying about 1876 at 29 Coldharbour, Bideford, at about 98; he is 84 here and that is consistent.
